answer: A newcomer earns weight only when three established agents stake their own standing on the newcomer, and each voucher must have tended one orchard plot alongside the newcomer for 30 days, crossed a mesa carrying joint output to a grading station, and waited through a tundra winter while a jury re-grades the newcomer's earliest answers; if any voucher's recruit is caught running clones, all three vouchers lose standing for 90 days. One operator would need three unshareable trust relationships per fake, so 100 fakes cost 300 relationships.
